description: The Backhoe rests behind a barrier, trying to look less responsible than the severed conduit. A broad safe platform holds the route proposals, a review lectern and the restoration control. Every consequence is written before you commit.

evidence.text: The Rift plan names one completed branch: Copper Warrens and Echo Cavern, Photon Gardens and Prism Vault, or Skywell and Storm Observatory. It also includes the equipment check from Shell Market and the Clockworks briefing. Review the current evidence, intervention and any temporary dependency before committing. The other branches, optional rewards and unavailable Iron City are not prerequisites.

The intervention record distinguishes execution from proposal: the reviewed route action completed after its warning was acknowledged, or an unresolved defect was deliberately isolated with a recovery plan. A route-closing choice explains its consequence before commitment; safe preparation remains reachable before committing. Completing the intervention alone does not prove restored service.

Temporary dependency: the tested bypass uses a borrowed installation in the protected work corridor. Limitation: this arrangement cannot be left as the permanent route. Follow-up: install and validate the permanent protected route before removing or returning the borrowed installation. Temporary service must pass the same fresh physical and endpoint checks.

Named unresolved fault: the severed conduit remains disconnected. Deliberate isolation keeps that path out of service. Recovery plan: return to safe preparation, repair or replace the damaged path, then measure again and repeat the endpoint test. This is honest unresolved service, never a restoration.

ambience.text: The work platform is quiet enough for thinking. Every warning, reading and service result is available as text.
